paragraphs: Before surgery, scrub, gown, drape, and count supplies. At the table, follow the lead surgeon's rhythm and have each instrument ready one step ahead. If bleeding occurs, immediately suction to expose the field and pass a hemostat. After surgery, verify all counts and send specimens. Quickly restock between consecutive procedures, then continue to the next operation.

In short: provide exactly the support the lead surgeon needs at the table.
